params.text: The approved palette. Every swatch is bound to its variable, so a token change moves the swatch.
The approved pairings, drawn as they are used. gnosix is a substrate system: the palette is fixed, the pairing carries the meaning.
Space Grotesk, the only visual family. Weights are the ratified four; the technical style adds tabular figures.
A design source of truth your agents can edit, render and hand off as code.

The ratified spacing steps. Each bar is bound to its variable, so the scale is the same scale the code uses.
The ratified glyphs and identity masters, imported as editable layers. Nothing here is a picture of a thing.
The six reference scenes, imported as editable frames. The layers inside them are vectors and text, not a picture.
The ratified rules. Each card carries its rule as an annotation, so Dev Mode shows the rule beside the thing it governs.
